sentences.en: On this week's episode, we're talking about backup plans.
sentences.zh: 在这一期的节目中，我们来聊聊备用计划。

sentences.en: Researcher Katie Milkman shares her study on why it's not always a good idea to have a plan B.

sentences.en: It may make you less motivated to pursue your primary goals.

sentences.en: Dan Pink is here for another round of stopwatch science.

sentences.en: So these are glorious times for scholars who research moral hazard.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于研究道德风险的学者来说，这是个辉煌的时代。

sentences.en: And we invited Matthew McConaughey to talk about the importance of backup plans in the movie Interstellar.

sentences.en: The researcher Katie Milkman at the University of Pennsylvania was very interested in what happens when we have backup plans.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学的研究员凯蒂·米尔克曼对我们拥有备用计划时会发生什么非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: We have this sense that having a security blanket or a backup plan B is a strategy that will be helpful to us.
sentences.zh: 我们有一种感觉，拥有安全毯或B计划是一种对我们有帮助的策略。

sentences.en: It'll make us more emotionally comfortable with our plans.
sentences.zh: 它会让我们的计划在情感上更让人安心。

sentences.en: It will make us feel like we're taking less risk.
sentences.zh: 它会让我们觉得自己承担的风险更小。

sentences.en: Katie Milkman tells me that there is a surprising downside to having that kind of safety net.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·米尔克曼告诉我，这种安全网其实有一个令人意想不到的负面影响。

sentences.en: It may make you less motivated to pursue your primary goals.
sentences.zh: 它可能会降低你追求首要目标的动力。

sentences.en: So because you know that all your eggs aren't in this one basket,

sentences.en: and not pushing as hard toward your primary goals.
sentences.zh: 不再那么拼命地去推进你的首要目标。

sentences.zh: 既然你知道事情总会好起来的，你随时都可以执行备用计划。
